lessonTitleEn: Particle Structure and Changes of State
contentObjectives: Describe the main assumptions of the particle model of matter.
Compare particle arrangement and motion in solids, liquids and gases.
Explain melting, freezing, vaporisation and condensation using the particle model.
languageObjectives: Use particle, solid, liquid, gas, melting and condensation in short English sentences.
Compare the three states of matter using whereas, closer together and move more freely.

keyConcepts.vi: Vật chất được cấu tạo từ các hạt rất nhỏ, các hạt chuyển động liên tục
keyConcepts.en: Matter consists of tiny particles that move continuously.

keyConcepts.vi: Giữa các hạt có tương tác
keyConcepts.en: Particles interact through attractive and repulsive forces.

keyConcepts.vi: Chuyển thể là sự chuyển từ trạng thái vật chất này sang trạng thái khác
keyConcepts.en: A change of state is a transition from one state of matter to another.

vocabulary.definitionEn: A tiny constituent used in the particle model of matter.
vocabulary.exampleEn: Matter is made of tiny particles.

vocabulary.definitionEn: A particle consisting of atoms bonded together.
vocabulary.exampleEn: Water molecules are in constant motion.

vocabulary.definitionEn: A state of matter with a stable shape and volume under ordinary conditions.
A state of matter with a definite volume but no fixed shape.
A state of matter that can fill its container.
A change from solid to liquid.
A change from liquid to solid.
A change from liquid to gas.
vocabulary.exampleEn: Vaporisation changes water into water vapour.

vocabulary.definitionEn: A change from gas to liquid.
Irregular motion of small suspended particles due to collisions with molecules.
vocabulary.exampleEn: Brownian motion provides evidence for the motion of molecules.

slides.title: Particle Structure and Changes of State
bullets: Look at ice, water and water vapour.
slides.teacherScript: Today we will use the particle model to explain solids, liquids and gases. Look at ice and water. What do you notice?

slides.title: The particle model
bullets: Matter is made of tiny particles.
slides.teacherScript: Matter is made of tiny particles. They always move. Particles also interact. Can you give an example?

slides.title: Solids, liquids and gases
bullets: Solid: particles close together, mainly vibrate.
Liquid: particles remain close but move past each other.
Gas: particles are far apart and move freely.
slides.teacherScript: In a solid, particles stay close and mainly vibrate. In a liquid, particles move past one another. In a gas, particles move freely.

slides.title: Changes of state
slides.teacherScript: When ice becomes water, we call it melting. The opposite change is freezing. Which process forms droplets from water vapour?

slides.title: Heating and a change of state
bullets: During melting or boiling at fixed pressure, temperature may remain constant.
Energy is used to change the state.
slides.teacherScript: During melting, the material can absorb energy even when its temperature stays constant. Why? The energy changes particle arrangement and interactions.

slides.title: Check your understanding
bullets: Why can gas fill a container?
What happens to particles during melting?
Explain condensation in your own words.
slides.teacherScript: Discuss in pairs. Use the terms particles, melting and condensation. Explain your answers using the model.

quiz.questionEn: Which statement best describes the particle model?
choices: Matter is made of tiny particles in motion.
quiz.explanationVi: Vật chất được cấu tạo từ các hạt rất nhỏ, luôn chuyển động và có tương tác.
Trong chất rắn, các hạt nằm gần nhau và chủ yếu dao động quanh vị trí cân bằng.
Nóng chảy là quá trình chuyển từ thể rắn sang thể lỏng.

quiz.questionEn: Which process forms water droplets from water vapour?
quiz.explanationVi: Ngưng tụ là quá trình chuyển từ thể khí sang thể lỏng.

quiz.questionEn: Why can temperature remain constant during melting?
choices: The absorbed energy contributes to the change of state.
The solid stops absorbing heat permanently.
quiz.explanationVi: Khi nóng chảy ở điều kiện thích hợp, năng lượng nhận được dùng cho biến đổi trạng thái; nhiệt độ có thể không đổi.
